Parameter_Name: Crane Glacier Basal Drag Coefficient (Post-Larsen B)
Physical_Role: Controls basal sliding resistance under Crane Glacier trunk
Underlying_Assumptions: Requires: 1) Geometry (H, s, b) perfectly synchronized to velocity epoch (2011-2016); 2) Static bed topography; 3) Unbuttressed boundary condition theta=0; 4) Negligible advective acceleration Du/Dt.
Transience_and_Geometry_Impact: High: Severe post-collapse dynamic thinning (dh/dt ~ -20 to -30 m/yr in 2002-2006). If 2002 geometry is used with 2015 velocity, C_bed is overestimated by 10x.
Grounding_Line_Migration_Impact: High: Terminus/GL retreated 5-10 km into overdeepened fjord. GL position mismatch directly alters driving stress and effective basal area.
Hydrological_and_Basal_Uncertainty: High: BedMachine bathymetry uncertainty in deep fjord canyon (+-75 m). Potential till dilation and transient subglacial water pressure spikes post-collapse.
Stage_3B_Mandate: Conditionally Invert: Must use 2011-2016 contemporary geometry and restrict calibration to synchronized multi-year epoch.

Parameter_Name: Ryder Glacier Basal Drag Coefficient (George VI Tributary)
Physical_Role: Controls basal sliding resistance under buttressed marine ice stream
Underlying_Assumptions: Requires decoupling from ice-shelf buttressing theta_buttress. Cannot be uniquely identified simultaneously with theta without prior constraint.
Transience_and_Geometry_Impact: Moderate: George VI Sound has quasi-steady elevation change relative to Larsen B (dh/dt ~ -0.5 to -1.5 m/yr).
Grounding_Line_Migration_Impact: Moderate: Broad, retrograde bed slope creates grounding line sensitivity to BedMachine bed errors.
Hydrological_and_Basal_Uncertainty: Moderate: Basal water pressure near flotation at grounding zone modulates effective normal stress N.
Stage_3B_Mandate: Calibrate via Sequential Hierarchy: Anchor unbuttressed basal friction prior from Crane/Leonardo, then invert for theta_buttress.

Physical_Role: Quantifies reduction in longitudinal tensile stress from downstream shelf confinement
Underlying_Assumptions: Identifiable only when C_bed is independently constrained or during natural unbuttressing experiments (Larsen B collapse).
Transience_and_Geometry_Impact: High: In transient collapse, theta drops instantaneously from ~0.80 to 0.0, inducing multi-year geometry evolution.
Grounding_Line_Migration_Impact: High: Shelf buttressing directly suppresses Schoof boundary layer flux as (1 - theta)^2.25.
Hydrological_and_Basal_Uncertainty: Low: Boundary stress parameter independent of subglacial till rheology.
Stage_3B_Mandate: Calibrate conditionally on buttressed systems (Ryder) after C_bed is bounded; set theta=0 on unbuttressed systems (Crane, Flanders).

Physical_Role: Parameterizes cross-channel velocity curvature and sidewall shear resistance
Underlying_Assumptions: Acts strictly in parallel with C_bed in 1D SSA. Pearson cosine similarity r = +0.8838; singular value sigma_5 = 0.0242 (1500x smaller than Mode 1).
Transience_and_Geometry_Impact: Moderate: Scales with ice thickness as (2H/W) * tau_wall.
Grounding_Line_Migration_Impact: Low: Affects channel dynamics but does not directly enter Schoof boundary-layer formula.
Hydrological_and_Basal_Uncertainty: Low: Governed by lateral rock sidewall friction and fjord width W.
Stage_3B_Mandate: Strictly Freeze: Lock to theoretical parabolic value kappa_shape=5.0 derived from 2D transverse Stokes integration.

Parameter_Name: Glen Flow Law Rate Factor A
Physical_Role: Ice rheological softness factor controlling viscous creep deformation
Underlying_Assumptions: In fast sliding trunks, longitudinal strain rate accounts for <8% of resistance. Log sensitivity S_u < 0.06 across 24x parameter range.
Transience_and_Geometry_Impact: Low: Rheology changes only on advective/thermal timescales (decades to centuries).
Grounding_Line_Migration_Impact: Moderate: Enters Schoof boundary flux as A^0.75, but collinear with C_schoof (r = +0.9572).
Stage_3B_Mandate: Strictly Freeze: Lock to Cuffey & Paterson (2010) temperature-parameterized value A = 3.5e-25 Pa^-3 s^-1 (-10 deg C).

Physical_Role: Asymptotic boundary-layer exponent relating ice thickness to discharge
Identifiability_Classification: Structurally Fixed by Asymptotic Boundary-Layer Theory
Underlying_Assumptions: Analytically derived from matched asymptotics: h_exp = (m + n + 3) / (m + 1). For n=3, m=1/3, h_exp = (1/3 + 3 + 3)/(1/3 + 1) = 19/4 = 4.75.
Transience_and_Geometry_Impact: Extreme: Logarithmic sensitivity S_D ~ 10.7 to 25.7. Mode 1 of SVD has 99.8% projection onto h_exp.
Grounding_Line_Migration_Impact: Extreme: Dominates grounding line flux response to retreat/advance.
Hydrological_and_Basal_Uncertainty: Moderate: BedMachine GL thickness errors (+-30 m) propagate as (1 +- 30/H)^4.75 ~ 50% flux shift.
Stage_3B_Mandate: Strictly Freeze: Lock to exact theoretical value h_exp = 4.75; never optimize as an empirical parameter.

Physical_Role: Dimensionless boundary-layer matching factor (absorbs 2D stress bridges, transition width, effective pressure)
Underlying_Assumptions: Identifiable from basin-wide altimetric mass budget (dh/dt) only if C_bed and A_glen are decoupled and not tuned simultaneously.
Grounding_Line_Migration_Impact: High: Directly controls mass export across grounding line.
Hydrological_and_Basal_Uncertainty: High: Absorbs deviations of basal effective pressure from pure hydrostatic connection in transition zone.
Stage_3B_Mandate: Calibrate at Regional Basin Scale: Invert C_schoof against satellite altimetry dh/dt after flowline C_bed is anchored.
